teamConflicts.title: Team ↔ meta-team mismatches
teamConflicts.summary: {teams} team(s) point to more than one meta-team · {cases} submission(s) affected. The meta-team is picked from a dropdown (the reliable side); the hand-typed team code is the one that usually goes wrong.
teamConflicts.truncated: Showing the first cases; {n} more remain — resolve this batch and reload.
teamConflicts.applyError: The correction could not be applied
teamConflicts.doneFailed: {n} correction(s) applied · {f} failed. Review and retry; if it persists, sync the form.
teamConflicts.summaryIntro: The TEAM of {n} submission(s) will be corrected, trusting their meta-team. Each correction is a real edit (written to KoboToolbox and recorded in the audit log and history).
teamConflicts.unresolvedNote: {n} case(s) without an automatic resolution will move to case-by-case confirmation.
teamConflicts.groupIntro: {n} submission(s) point to the meta-team “{label}” but carry a team from another meta-team. Pick the team that will be assigned to ALL these cases.
teamConflicts.noCandidates: No team resolves to this meta-team: there is no candidate to propose (the team may be correct and the mistyped side may be the meta-team).
teamConflicts.caseIntro: The meta-team (picked from a dropdown) is trusted: choose the correct team of “{meta}”.
teamConflicts.optFixMeta: Rare case: the team “{team}” is correct — fix the META-TEAM to “{label}”
